decision.reason: [ev-184bc27865b1] is a single changelog line saying only that the application controller now stores application health status in Redis by default. It doesn't say where health status was stored before, which setting or flag controls this or whether you can opt out, or what changes for an operator who does nothing (for example, whether health stops appearing in a place it used to). The line only points to PRs #10312 and #21532. To write the subject, applicability and consequence, we need the upgrade guide or the PR text.
